title: Identify the end points
text: We saw that the domain is $$[-2,2]$$ and the range is $$[0, \pi].$$ We know that when $$x=2, $$ $$\theta=0;$$ when $$x=-2, $$ $$\theta=\pi.$$

title: Compare domains and ranges
text: We see that C is the only viable option as it has the correct domain, range and behavior at the end points. Observe that it is the same as the graph in A, only stretched horizontally.
